recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, high-contrast group portrait of four men in urban attire, dominated by a deep purple and indigo color wash. The central figure is in sharp focus, angled toward the viewer, while others are positioned in the background with varying degrees of shadow and focus, creating a sense of depth and collective identity.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the mid-ground with a dynamic, angled pose.
Background figures provide a rhythmic repetition of silhouettes.
Deep shadows blend the subjects' clothing into the dark background.
High-key highlights on skin and leather create texture against the purple wash.
coreInvariants: Urban 1990s fashion including leather and dark fabrics.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is centered and scaled to fill the vertical height; secondary subjects are clustered behind him.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The highlighted face and shoulder of the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central face, moves down the highlight of the arm, then circles to the background figures and the top-right text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark, shadowed negative space in the lower half and corners to emphasize the subjects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; the image relies on light vs. dark rather than hue variety.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like red, orange, or yellow.
Limit to a monochromatic purple spectrum.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a wide, extended serif for the primary name.
Secondary text uses a condensed, all-caps sans-serif.
Bottom-left logo uses a tall, compressed sans-serif with heavy weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extreme horizontal tracking in the subtitle text.
Vertical compression in the bottom-left branding.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between wide, elegant serifs and tall, aggressive sans-serifs.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rules or spacing to separate text lines.
Small iconographic element integrated into the bottom-left text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, small-serif look of the top display text.
Matches the tall, dense feel of the bottom-left branding.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of four men in 90s urban fashion (leather jackets, dark shirts) posing in a high-contrast studio setting. Apply a heavy monochromatic deep purple and indigo color grade. The lighting should be dramatic, hitting the faces and shoulders while leaving the rest in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add all-caps white text. Place a wide serif font at the top center with generous tracking. Place a tall, ultra-condensed sans-serif logo in the bottom-left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly purple, black, and white?
Is the lighting high-contrast with visible skin texture?
Are the fonts all-caps and varied in width?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the subtitle text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the purple wash doesn't muddy the highlights.
Check that the text is perfectly legible against the dark background.
Verify the 90s urban fashion style is accurately represented.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the asymmetrical text placement.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Group Portrait + Monochromatic Purple Grade + High Contrast Lighting + Wide Serif/Condensed Sans-Serif Typographic Pairing.
